top_signals.title: S&P 500 Bounces as Chip Rout Spurs Stock Rotation: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: Wall Street traders drove a rotation out of high-profile chipmakers and into a broader category of companies while pushing investors toward the safety of bonds.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
